examples.input: Create Google Search ads for an online accounting software targeting small business owners. Product is $29/month. Key selling points: easy invoicing, automatic bank reconciliation, tax-ready reports. We're competing with QuickBooks and FreshBooks.

campaign_brief.target_audience: Small business owners, freelancers, solopreneurs searching for accounting solutions
campaign_brief.competitive_differentiators: Simpler than QuickBooks, cheaper than FreshBooks, designed for non-accountants

headlines: Your Books, Always Up to Date
descriptions: Stop wrestling with spreadsheets. Send invoices, track expenses, and generate tax reports in one simple app. Start your free trial today.
Automatic bank feeds, one-click reconciliation, and tax-ready reports. Everything a small business needs — nothing it doesn't. Try free for 14 days.
Join 2,000+ small business owners who switched to simpler accounting. Easy setup, no training needed. $29/mo after free trial. Cancel anytime.
Professional invoices in 60 seconds. Automatic expense categorization. Quarterly tax estimates. All for $29/month. See why owners are switching.
ad_group_1.pinning: Pin 'Small Business Accounting Made Easy' to Position 1. Pin '$29/Month' or 'Free 14-Day Trial' to Position 2 for price/offer visibility.

headlines: All the Features, Half the Price
ad_group_2.note: Do NOT use 'QuickBooks' in ad copy — trademark policy violation. Use competitor keyword targeting with your own brand messaging.

examples.input: Create Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads for a direct-to-consumer premium dog food brand. Product: fresh, human-grade dog food delivered monthly. Price: $60-$120/month depending on dog size. Target: millennial dog owners who treat their dogs like family.

campaign_brief.target_audience: Dog owners 28-42, household income $75K+, interested in pet health, organic food, and premium pet products. They call their dog their 'child' unironically.

ad_set_1.audience: Interest-based: Dog owners + organic food + pet health

variations.primary_text:
The ingredient list on your dog's food should scare you.

Most kibble contains: meat by-products (that means beaks, hooves, and feathers), artificial preservatives linked to cancer, and 'natural flavors' that are anything but natural.

Your dog eats the same thing every single day. Shouldn't it be real food?

🥩 Human-grade beef, chicken & turkey
🥕 Fresh vegetables — no fillers
📦 Delivered monthly, pre-portioned for your dog

Take the 2-minute quiz to build your dog's custom meal plan.
variations.headline: Real Food for Real Dogs

variations.primary_text:
"My vet asked what I changed. Tucker's coat is shinier, he has more energy, and his digestive issues are completely gone."
— Sarah M., Golden Retriever mom

We hear stories like this every day. Turns out, feeding your dog actual food (not processed pellets) makes a visible difference in 2-3 weeks.

✅ Human-grade ingredients
✅ Vet-formulated recipes
✅ Custom portions for your dog's breed, age & weight

Start with 50% off your first box.
variations.headline: See the Difference in 2 Weeks

variations.primary_text:
You wouldn't eat the same processed meal every day for your entire life.

So why does your dog?

[Product] delivers fresh, vet-formulated meals made from ingredients you'd actually recognize: real chicken, sweet potatoes, spinach, and blueberries.

Because the best member of your family deserves better than mystery kibble.
variations.headline: They Deserve Better Than Kibble

creative_direction.video_ad_1: Before/after split screen — same dog, dull coat eating kibble vs. shiny coat eating fresh food. 15 seconds, text overlay, trending audio.
creative_direction.video_ad_2: POV: You meal prep for your dog. Show fresh ingredients being prepared, portioned, and your dog devouring it. Aspirational, warm lighting.
creative_direction.static_ad: Ingredient comparison: left side shows kibble ingredient list (long, unreadable), right side shows [Product] ingredient list (short, recognizable). Clean design.

testing_plan.variable: Problem vs Social Proof vs Emotional
testing_plan.hypothesis: Problem hook will have highest CTR, Social Proof will have highest conversion rate

testing_plan.variable: '50% off first box' vs 'Starting at $2/day' vs 'Free trial box'
testing_plan.hypothesis: 50% off will drive highest signup rate

examples.input: Create Google and Meta ads for a B2B cybersecurity training platform. Target: IT managers and CISOs at mid-market companies. Product: annual subscription, $5,000/year. Goal: demo requests.

headlines: Book a Demo — See Results in 30s
descriptions: 94% completion rates because employees actually enjoy our training. Phishing simulations, interactive modules, and automated compliance reporting. Book a 15-min demo.
Your employees click 1 in 5 phishing emails. Our platform reduces that to 1 in 50. Real attack simulations, personalized training paths, and CISO-ready dashboards.
SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS compliance training with automated reporting. Stop scrambling before audits. Continuous training that maps to every major framework.
Mid-market companies can't afford a breach. We make enterprise-grade security training accessible. Custom programs, real phishing sims, measurable behavior change.

meta_linkedin.note: For B2B cybersecurity at $5K/year, LinkedIn Ads will significantly outperform Meta for this audience. Recommend shifting 70% of social budget to LinkedIn.

linkedin_ad.primary_text:
Your employees are your biggest security vulnerability — and your best defense.

85% of data breaches involve human error. But most security training is a once-a-year checkbox that employees click through in 20 minutes.

That's not training. That's compliance theater.

[Product] delivers continuous, adaptive security training that actually changes behavior:
→ Real phishing simulations (not obvious test emails)
→ 5-minute micro-lessons triggered by risky behavior
→ Department-specific threat scenarios
→ CISO dashboard with risk scores by team

Result: 75% reduction in phishing click rates within 90 days.

Book a 15-minute demo and see your organization's simulated risk score.
linkedin_ad.headline: Security Training That Changes Behavior
